shellCommands.command: git status --short && git ls-files | head -100 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null
cat src/App.tsx && echo ---- && cat src/main.tsx && echo ---- && cat index.html && echo ---- && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts src/vite-env.d.ts .gitignore && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -5

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80 && grep -ril "calendar" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components --include=*.d.ts | head -20

grep -ril "calendar" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | tail -30; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@latest peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40; for v in 3.0.0 3.1.0 4.0.0 4.1.0 4.2.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null; done

npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils@2 version 2>/dev/null | tail -3; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 dependencies --json 2>/dev/null; npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -15

cat package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist 2>/dev/null | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types)"'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components -name "*.d.ts" | grep -iE "calendar/index|DatePicker/index|index.d.ts" | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm && ls components && cat components/Calendar/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat components/Calendar/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80

cat components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -60; sed -n 1,80p components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts; grep -n "dateTime\|export" ../../../../date-utils/dist/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls date-components/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls date-components/ ; grep -rn "dateTime\b" date-utils/dist/esm/index.d.ts | head -5; grep -rln "export declare function dateTime\|dateTime(" date-utils/dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5
ls date-utils/ && cat date-utils/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types)"'; cat date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls date-components/dist/docs/components 2>/dev/null | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components && cat Calendar.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build && grep -E "export" index.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "loadLocale" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5; grep -rn "Russian\|'ru'" ../../date-components/dist/docs/components/*.md | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit $?"; git status --short; git diff --stat

rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "^playwright|puppeteer" ) ; echo done
sed -i "s#appType: 'custom', logLevel: 'error' }#appType: 'custom', logLevel: 'error', ssr: { noExternal: [/@gravity-ui/] } }#" /tmp/smoke/ssr.mjs && node /tmp/smoke/ssr.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /tmp/smoke && timeout 170 npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout 160 npm install playwright@1.47.2 --silent 2>&1 | tail -3; timeout 300 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "exit $?"
cd /tmp/smoke && timeout 300 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*at " | head -15; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
cd /tmp/smoke && timeout 120 node e2e.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v "║" | head -12; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1134/ 2>/dev/null; cat vite.log | tail -3
ldconfig -p | grep -E "libnss3|libgbm|libasound" | head -3; sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo SUDO_OK; head -5 /tmp/smoke/vite.log; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5179/
git diff package.json && cat src/App.tsx && npm run build >/tmp/smoke/build.log 2>&1; echo "build exit $?"; rm -rf dist; git status --short
